text: Consider the equation $$ \begin{bmatrix} 2 \amp 1 \\ 2 \amp 0 \\ -1 \amp 3 \\ \end{bmatrix} \xvec = \threevec{16}{-1}7 $$ with matrix $A$ and vector $\bvec$. Since this equation is inconsistent, we will find the least-squares approximate solution $\xhat$ by solving the normal equation $A^TA\xhat = A^T\bvec$, which has the form $$ A^TA\xhat = \begin{bmatrix} 9 \amp -1 \\ -1 \amp 10 \\ \end{bmatrix} \xhat = \twovec{23}{37} = A^T\bvec $$ and the solution $\xhat=\twovec34$.
